units: blocks; size is width, depth, height; rectangular endpoints exclusive

plains.title: Plains
plains.decision: Keep unequal gables and an open side arch; refine the existing prototype.

desert.title: Desert
desert.decision: Cut sandstone walls with smooth trim; stepped flat roofs; east shade arcade.

savanna.title: Savanna
savanna.decision: Shallow hipped roofs. Compact depth grows to 13 to retain rear alcove access.

taiga.title: Taiga
taiga.decision: Framed spruce panels, steep roof and a long compact hall.

snowy.title: Snowy
snowy.decision: Offset inner lobby opening; protected court. Rear courtyard hall moves back two blocks.

ocean.title: Deep ocean · Tidal Towns
ocean.decision: Compact raft grows to 16 × 15 for a two-block side and aft walk; one gangway.

jungle.title: Jungle · MMV
jungle.decision: Jungle wood and stone dominate; a shallow stair joins the low raised floor.

swamp.title: Swamp · MMV
palette: Dark oak roof / mud brick accents
swamp.decision: Dark oak and mud brick; dry raised deck, with a protected refuge on wet sites.
